dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: I humbly offer this prayer to our god: May the winds of the wild bring blessings upon you, washing away all your weariness and fatigue...

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: ...Eh, that'll probably do. I think I'll just skip the second half. This is supposed to be a break, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Hey, don't look so shocked. Since we're on a break, we might as well give the Archon a break too. He can't be listening to our prayers all the time!
